description: One-click demo and development corpus. Audio is not in git: local copies live in demo/audio/, deployed copies in the bucket under demo/audio/. Real use analyses whatever the user uploads.
global_comment: Focus on the drops. I want the kick and bass to hit harder without losing the darker tone I have now.
